scope: Root floating-point complete-memory comparison of fixed compiled schedules in one supplied physical model and static uncertainty family. No empirical acquisition, threshold, optimality, interval audit, or universal impossibility is claimed.
algebraic_family_calibration: Nominal c=.925 fixes the target duration. Each compiled gate is tested without further parameter-dependent angle fitting.
ordinary_calibration: Nominal full native model and uncertainty family supplied for classical optimization; their physical acquisition is not demonstrated.
additional_costs: Preparation, readout, qualification/calibration trials, holding during those trials, control execution errors, and any entropy export remain additional physical costs.
